stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 12% acid be mixed with a solution containing 28% acid to obtain a mixture that is 18% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{28 - 18}{18 - 12} = \dfrac{10}{6} = 5:3$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 2).
